title: RFC 3977 conformance: OVER/XOVER overview correctness
description:
Test OVER with range, with single article number, and with message-ID. Test XOVER as alias. Verify all 7 tab-separated fields are present: Subject, From, Date, Message-ID, References, :bytes, :lines. Verify field values match article headers. Artifact: tests/conformance/over_xover.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- OVER 1-10 returns 10 lines for a 10-article group
- All 7 required fields present in every line
- XOVER returns identical output to OVER for same range
- OVER with missing article numbers in range skips them (no error)
- Thunderbird's message list pane correctly populates from the OVER output
